title: China-to-Azerbaijan Power Tool Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: Electrical Safety Under AZS and GOST-Adopted IEC Standards
rows.target_requirement: Azerbaijan regulates power-tool electrical safety through the national standardization and conformity system led by AZSTAND or AzStandard, using AZS standards and GOST-adopted IEC standards for regulated goods. For corded and cordless power tools, the practical technical anchor is the applicable GOST IEC 60745 or GOST IEC 62841 family for hand-held, transportable, and garden electric tools, with conformity certification before placement. Azerbaijan uses a 220/380 V, 50 Hz grid, which genuinely matches China's 220/380 V, 50 Hz nominal supply, but plugs, markings, instructions, and the recognised AZS or GOST edition still need target-market confirmation.
target_standards: Azerbaijan AZS national standards and GOST-adopted IEC 60745 or IEC 62841 series for electric motor-operated hand-held, transportable, and lawn and garden tools
AZSTAND or AzStandard conformity certification for regulated goods
Azerbaijan mains 220/380 V 50 Hz marking and national-language user information
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool safety files commonly use China GB 3883 or GB/T 3883, aligned with the IEC 62841 family, with CCC where applicable. China's 220/380 V, 50 Hz nominal grid is a genuine technical match to Azerbaijan's 220/380 V, 50 Hz supply, but the China report and CCC status do not automatically replace Azerbaijan conformity certification or national-language labelling.
rows.gap: The core safety standard family and grid rating are close, but the file must be remapped to the Azerbaijan-recognised AZS or GOST IEC edition, routed through the national conformity certification channel for regulated goods, and supported by national-language marking and instructions. TR CU or TR EAEU certification is not the Azerbaijan route because Azerbaijan is not an EAEU member.

target.en: Mandatory in practice for regulated power tools: conformity certification against the applicable Azerbaijan-recognised AZS or GOST IEC 60745 or 62841 safety standard, with national-language labelling and 220/380 V 50 Hz marking as applicable.
target.zh: 对列管电动工具属实务强制：按阿塞拜疆认可的适用 AZS 或 GOST IEC 60745 或 62841 安全标准完成合格认证，并按适用情况提供本国语言标签和 220/380 V 50 Hz 标识。
target.zht: 對列管電動工具屬實務強制：按亞塞拜然認可的適用 AZS 或 GOST IEC 60745 或 62841 安全標準完成合格認證，並按適用情況提供本國語言標籤和 220/380 V 50 Hz 標識。

cn.en: China domestic baseline commonly uses GB 3883 or GB/T 3883, GB 4343 EMC, and CCC where applicable.
cn.zh: 中国境内基线通常采用 GB 3883 或 GB/T 3883、GB 4343 EMC，部分类别适用 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內基線通常採用 GB 3883 或 GB/T 3883、GB 4343 EMC，部分類別適用 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Technically close on voltage and IEC-derived safety content, but not Azerbaijan-ready until the file is mapped to the recognised AZS or GOST IEC edition, national conformity certification is completed, and Azerbaijan-language marking and instructions are prepared.

source.publisher: Azerbaijan Standardization Institute and State Service for Antimonopoly Supervision and Control over Consumer Market

rows.requirement: EMC Evidence Under National Conformity Certification
rows.target_requirement: Azerbaijan market access for regulated electrical goods may require EMC evidence as part of national conformity certification, using AZS standards or GOST-adopted CIS and IEC-based EMC standards. For power tools, the practical target file should include emissions and immunity evidence acceptable to the Azerbaijan conformity body, plus labelling and instructions in the required national language. Azerbaijan is not an EAEU member, so TR CU 020 or TR EAEU EMC documents should not be presented as the controlling target-market legal route.
target_standards: Azerbaijan national conformity certification for regulated electrical goods
AZS or GOST-adopted EMC standards recognised by Azerbaijan conformity bodies
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool EMC evidence commonly references GB 4343 series and related GB EMC standards, with CCC where applicable. This is useful technical evidence, but the target side still needs acceptance against Azerbaijan-recognised AZS or GOST-adopted EMC standards and certification practice.
china_standards: GB 4343 series for household appliances, electric tools, and similar apparatus EMC
rows.gap: The exporter should not rely on EAEU EMC paperwork or China GB 4343 evidence alone. The gap is to identify the Azerbaijan-recognised EMC standard, confirm whether the tool category is in the regulated-goods certification list, and package the EMC report with national-language documentation for the conformity body and Baku port clearance.

target.en: Mandatory where the power tool or charger is treated as a regulated electrical good requiring national conformity certification; Azerbaijan-recognised EMC evidence is expected in the certification file.
target.zh: 当电动工具或充电器被视为需国家合格认证的列管电气商品时属强制；认证文件中预期包含阿塞拜疆认可的 EMC 证据。
target.zht: 當電動工具或充電器被視為需國家合格認證的列管電氣商品時屬強制；認證文件中預期包含亞塞拜然認可的 EMC 證據。

cn.en: China domestic baseline commonly uses GB 4343 EMC evidence and CCC where applicable.
cn.zh: 中国境内基线通常采用 GB 4343 EMC 证据，部分类别适用 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內基線通常採用 GB 4343 EMC 證據，部分類別適用 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Azerbaijan-ready if the file only contains China GB 4343 or EAEU EMC paperwork. The EMC evidence should be mapped to Azerbaijan-recognised AZS or GOST-adopted standards and included in the national conformity certification package.

source.publisher: Azerbaijan Standardization Institute and State Service for Antimonopoly Supervision and Control over Consumer Market

rows.requirement: Market Access, Local Importer, and Baku Port Clearance
rows.target_requirement: Power tools entering Azerbaijan should be planned around national AZSTAND or AzStandard conformity certification for regulated goods, an Azerbaijan importer or responsible party, national-language labelling and instructions, and customs clearance commonly routed through Baku on the Caspian Sea. The technical file should identify the recognised AZS or GOST-adopted standards for the tool, charger, battery pack, and EMC aspects. Azerbaijan is not in the EAEU, so TR CU or TR EAEU certificates are supporting commercial evidence at most, not the national market-access route.
target_standards: AZSTAND or AzStandard national conformity certification for regulated goods
Azerbaijan importer or responsible-party documentation for customs and surveillance contact
Baku port or Caspian logistics clearance documentation
rows.china_equivalent: China domestic power-tool records commonly contain GB 3883 or GB/T 3883 safety reports, GB 4343 EMC reports, and CCC status where applicable. These records support technical review but do not appoint an Azerbaijan importer, satisfy local labelling, or replace Azerbaijan national conformity certification and customs clearance.
rows.gap: The operational gap is to lock the Azerbaijan importer or responsible party, confirm whether the SKU is on the regulated-goods certification list, obtain the national conformity document against the recognised AZS or GOST-adopted standards, localise labels and instructions, and prepare Baku port clearance documents before dispatch.

target.en: Mandatory operational baseline for regulated goods: Azerbaijan national conformity certification, local importer or responsible-party file, national-language labelling, and customs-ready documentation for Baku or other entry route.
target.zh: 列管商品的强制运营基线：阿塞拜疆国家合格认证、本地进口商或责任主体文件、本国语言标签，以及面向巴库或其他入境路径的可清关文件。
target.zht: 列管商品的強制營運基線：亞塞拜然國家合格認證、本地進口商或責任主體文件、本國語言標籤，以及面向巴庫或其他入境路徑的可清關文件。

cn.en: China GB and CCC records are domestic baseline records and do not replace Azerbaijan importer, labelling, certification, or customs obligations.
cn.zh: 中国 GB 和 CCC 记录是境内基线文件，不能替代阿塞拜疆进口商、标签、认证或海关义务。
cn.zht: 中國 GB 和 CCC 記錄是境內基線文件，不能替代亞塞拜然進口商、標籤、認證或海關義務。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Azerbaijan-ready operationally until the importer or responsible party, national conformity certification, local labelling, and Baku port or equivalent customs file are locked before shipment. TR CU or TR EAEU evidence should not be treated as the Azerbaijan route.

source.publisher: Azerbaijan Standardization Institute and State Service for Antimonopoly Supervision and Control over Consumer Market

rows.requirement: Noise, Vibration, and Workplace Safety Claims
rows.target_requirement: Azerbaijan does not operate the EU outdoor equipment noise directive as its own horizontal power-tool placement regime. Noise and vibration information for power tools is instead handled through product safety standards, workplace or occupational health and safety expectations, user instructions, and any applicable national sanitary or labour rules. For outdoor tools, measured sound power or sound pressure data can still be useful, but the target-market claim should be framed under Azerbaijan-recognised AZS or GOST-adopted tool standards and OHS practice rather than EU Directive 2000/14/EC.
target_standards: Azerbaijan-recognised AZS or GOST-adopted power-tool safety standards requiring noise and vibration information where applicable
Azerbaijan occupational health and safety or workplace exposure rules
National-language user instructions and safety warnings
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool files commonly include noise and vibration values under GB 3883 or GB/T 3883 tool-safety testing, plus workplace safety information where relevant. Those values can support the Azerbaijan file but do not create an EU outdoor-noise declaration and do not replace national-language warnings or local OHS review.
china_standards: GB 3883 and GB/T 3883 noise and vibration test information
China workplace safety information where applicable
rows.gap: The main gap is claim framing: do not import the EU outdoor-noise directive into the Azerbaijan column. Keep measured noise and vibration values, translate safety warnings, map the values to the recognised AZS or GOST-adopted tool standard, and treat workplace exposure control as an OHS issue rather than a CE-style outdoor-noise marking route.

target.en: Mandatory where required by the applicable AZS or GOST-adopted safety standard, workplace rules, or product instructions; no EU outdoor equipment noise directive applies as Azerbaijan law.
target.zh: 在适用 AZS 或采纳 GOST 的安全标准、工作场所规则或产品说明书要求时属强制；欧盟户外设备噪声指令不作为阿塞拜疆法律适用。
target.zht: 在適用 AZS 或採納 GOST 的安全標準、工作場所規則或產品說明書要求時屬強制；歐盟戶外設備噪聲指令不作為亞塞拜然法律適用。

cn.en: China files commonly contain GB 3883 or GB/T 3883 noise and vibration data as part of the safety baseline.
cn.zh: 中国文件通常将 GB 3883 或 GB/T 3883 噪声和振动数据作为安全基线的一部分。
cn.zht: 中國文件通常將 GB 3883 或 GB/T 3883 噪聲和振動數據作為安全基線的一部分。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Azerbaijan-ready if the noise file is copied from an EU outdoor-noise directive route. Use measured noise and vibration data under the recognised AZS or GOST-adopted tool standard and national OHS context, with translated safety warnings.

source.publisher: Azerbaijan Standardization Institute and State Service for Antimonopoly Supervision and Control over Consumer Market

rows.requirement: Restricted Substances Without an EU-Style Horizontal RoHS Regime
rows.target_requirement: Azerbaijan should not be treated as having the EU RoHS directive or an EAEU-style horizontal electrical-equipment restricted-substance regime for power tools. Restricted-substance and material-safety evidence may still be requested through product standards, customs documentation, buyer specifications, chemical or environmental rules, and general safety review, but the target column should state plainly that there is no horizontal EU-style RoHS route for Azerbaijan power-tool placement.
target_standards: Azerbaijan product standards and conformity review where material safety is relevant
Azerbaijan chemical, environmental, customs, or buyer documentation requirements where applicable
No Azerbaijan horizontal EU-style RoHS regime for power tools identified in this informational matrix
rows.china_equivalent: China files may include China RoHS declarations, supplier material declarations, and GB 3883 or GB/T 3883 material-safety information. These records are useful supporting evidence, but they are not a substitute for Azerbaijan-specific product-standard, customs, or buyer requirements and should not be labelled as Azerbaijan RoHS compliance.
rows.gap: The compliance gap is honesty of mapping: do not copy the EU RoHS or EAEU hazardous-substance lane into Azerbaijan. Keep China RoHS and material declarations as supporting evidence, screen customer and customs requirements, and avoid claiming an Azerbaijan horizontal RoHS certificate unless a current local legal basis is confirmed.

target.en: No horizontal EU-style RoHS regime is identified for Azerbaijan power tools in this matrix; material-safety controls may still be mandatory through product, customs, environmental, or buyer-specific routes.
target.zh: 本矩阵未识别阿塞拜疆电动工具存在横向欧盟式 RoHS 制度；材料安全控制仍可能通过产品、海关、环境或买方特定路径成为强制要求。
target.zht: 本矩陣未識別亞塞拜然電動工具存在橫向歐盟式 RoHS 制度；材料安全控制仍可能透過產品、海關、環境或買方特定路徑成為強制要求。

cn.en: China RoHS and material declarations are supporting records and do not establish Azerbaijan RoHS compliance.
cn.zh: 中国 RoHS 和材料声明是支持性记录，不能构成阿塞拜疆 RoHS 合规。
cn.zht: 中國 RoHS 和材料聲明是支援性記錄，不能構成亞塞拜然 RoHS 合規。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not mark the product Azerbaijan-ready on the basis of EU RoHS or EAEU restricted-substance paperwork. Treat China RoHS and material declarations as supporting evidence and confirm any product, customs, environmental, or buyer-specific substance controls separately.

source.publisher: Azerbaijan Standardization Institute and State Service for Antimonopoly Supervision and Control over Consumer Market

rows.requirement: Cordless Tool Batteries, Chargers, and Radio Modules
rows.target_requirement: For cordless power tools, the battery pack and charger should be handled as safety-critical components in the Azerbaijan conformity file. The practical anchor is GOST IEC 62133 or an Azerbaijan-recognised equivalent for rechargeable lithium battery safety, plus charger safety and EMC evidence under AZS or GOST-adopted standards. If the cordless tool, battery, or charger includes Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, cellular, or another radio module, separate national radio approval through the Azerbaijan communications authority may be required before import or sale.
target_standards: GOST IEC 62133 or Azerbaijan-recognised equivalent for rechargeable lithium battery safety
AZS or GOST-adopted charger safety and EMC standards
Azerbaijan national radio-equipment approval for tools, batteries, or chargers with radio modules
rows.china_equivalent: China files commonly combine GB 3883 or GB/T 3883 tool safety, GB 4343 EMC, lithium battery safety or transport evidence such as UN 38.3, and CCC where applicable to chargers or adapters. This evidence supports review but does not automatically satisfy Azerbaijan's GOST IEC 62133 battery mapping, charger certification, EMC acceptance, or national radio approval.
china_standards: CCC for chargers or adapters where applicable
rows.gap: The exporter should split the cordless file into tool, charger, battery pack, transport, and radio-module workstreams. GOST IEC 62133 battery evidence, charger safety, EMC acceptance, national-language instructions, and radio approval for connected models should be confirmed before booking the Baku route.

target.en: Mandatory where the battery pack, charger, or radio module falls within Azerbaijan regulated goods, battery-safety, EMC, transport, or radio-equipment approval practice; GOST IEC 62133 is the practical battery-safety anchor.
target.zh: 当电池包、充电器或无线电模块落入阿塞拜疆列管商品、电池安全、EMC、运输或无线电设备批准实务时属强制；GOST IEC 62133 是实务电池安全锚点。
target.zht: 當電池包、充電器或無線電模組落入亞塞拜然列管商品、電池安全、EMC、運輸或無線電設備批准實務時屬強制；GOST IEC 62133 是實務電池安全錨點。

cn.en: China tool, EMC, battery transport, and charger records are useful but do not automatically replace Azerbaijan battery, charger, EMC, or radio approval.
cn.zh: 中国工具、EMC、电池运输和充电器记录有用，但不会自动替代阿塞拜疆电池、充电器、EMC 或无线电批准。
cn.zht: 中國工具、EMC、電池運輸和充電器記錄有用，但不會自動替代亞塞拜然電池、充電器、EMC 或無線電批准。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Azerbaijan-ready for cordless or connected tools until battery safety is mapped to GOST IEC 62133 or an accepted equivalent, charger safety and EMC are included in the national conformity file, and any radio module is cleared through the national communications approval route.

source.publisher: Ministry of Digital Development and Transport of the Republic of Azerbaijan
